title: Albany Distilling Company
about: Albany Distilling Company calls itself the first licensed distillery in Albany since Prohibition. Teachers John Curtin and Matthew Jager opened it in 2011 in a small space on Montgomery Street, beside the Albany Pump Station and close to where the Quackenbush Still House, the city’s first distillery, operated in the mid-1700s. Curtin and co-owner Rick Sicari have since grown it into a much larger production house on Third Street, with a bar and bottle shop downtown.
Eden pours four of their spirits. Find them on the spirits list in our menu.
